summary: Tested the full signature feature suite on backend and frontend. BACKEND: new pytest file test_signature_features.py, 10/10 passing. Covered: public /network stats (no auth, no PII), facility requests with care_handoff/storm_priority plus an MT- seal code that persists and shows in /facility/deliveries, public /verify (journey only, no recipient name/phone/address leak; lowercase code and code without the prefix both resolve; unknown code returns 404), /jobs/routes bundles (10% bonus maths correct, addresses hidden) and /routes/accept (+10% payout, route_bundle=true, re-accept returns 400, facility gets 403), verify-seal (403 for a facility user or a non-assigned driver, 400 for wrong stage, 422 for a bad stage, seal_verified and seal_exception events created, dispatcher notified on a broken seal), storm-ready GET/PUT plus the public count changing by 1, and the regression accept, pickup checklist, evidence upload, delivered. Extra probes (probe_it23*.py) CONFIRMED 2 business-logic exploits in route bundles and 2 smaller SealTrace integrity gaps. FRONTEND (Playwright 1920x1080): landing badge, 4 signature cards, live network stats and partner chips, and the landing seal input that navigates to /verify/MT-XXX all work. /verify shows a real code's timeline and both seal checks with no PII, and a bogus code shows verify-error. In the facility portal the toggles work, the toast shows the seal code, and the list shows seal-row, copy-seal and the Care handoff / Storm priority badges. On the driver Job Board, Hamilton and Toronto bundles render, accept-bundle-Hamilton-btn accepted both, and My Jobs shows boosted payouts ($111.45 to $122.60, $115.05 to $126.56). Badges show on available cards. Active delivery with the pickup seal check, checklist, transit, arrived, delivery seal check, care-handoff-notice, signature and Mark Delivered all worked; the public verify page then showed Delivered with both checks intact. The dashboard storm-ready toggle persists after reload. Single-job accept regression passed. One uncaught runtime error: the copy-seal clipboard rejection.

critical.issue: Payouts can be compounded without limit. Cancel reopens the job but never resets payout_amount, offered_price, route_bundle or bundle_bonus. So the driver can accept a bundle (+10%), cancel for free inside the 5-minute grace period, and re-accept the bundle (+10% on top of the already boosted amount). Reproduced: 59.40 -> 65.34 -> 71.87 -> 79.06 over 3 rounds, no fees charged. The facility also sees the inflated payout_amount (79.06, route_bundle=true), so it is billed for it.

The server never checks that the submitted job_ids form a real neighbourhood bundle. Any 2 or more open jobs from any cities get +10%. Reproduced: Ottawa + Sudbury accepted together, 687.60 -> 756.36 and 657.30 -> 723.03. It also skips the checks used for single accept: the cold-chain certification filter, declined_by, and offered jobs. The update is not atomic (find, then update_one without a {status:'open'} filter), so two drivers racing can both win. A concurrent test returned [400, 200] this time, but the code is not race-safe.

minor.issue: Repeated checks are accepted for the same stage (got 200, 200, 200, 200). After a driver reports intact:false, sending intact:true again overwrites seal_pickup_verified back to true. The public journey then shows intact, intact, intact, broken, which undermines the tamper-evident claim. Make each stage's check write-once, or require dispatcher resolution after an exception.

The SealTrace pickup check is optional: pickup can be confirmed without any seal check (got 201), and the UI does not gate Confirm Pickup on it either. If SealTrace is meant to be mandatory, require seal_pickup_verified on pickup and seal_delivery_verified on delivered.

seal_checks_passed counts every seal_verified custody event, including events from deleted jobs and repeat checks on the same job (5 shown while only 3 deliveries are completed). Count distinct job+stage pairs for jobs that still exist. Partner city also comes out inconsistent ('Toronto ON' vs 'Toronto') because _city_of(address) takes the second comma segment.

The seal code is only 6 hex characters (16.7M possibilities) on a public endpoint with no auth and no rate limit, so codes can be enumerated to scrape facility name, route cities, item_category and timestamps. Add rate limiting and/or a longer code.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...) is neither awaited nor caught. When clipboard permission is denied (iframes, some browsers, non-secure contexts) this throws an uncaught 'NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText' that shows the CRA runtime error overlay, and the success toast fires anyway. Wrap it in try/catch with an error toast or a fallback.

issues: care-handoff-notice appears only at Stage 3 (Delivery). At Stage 1 (Pickup) a driver is not told the job needs extra time with the patient; consider showing it at pickup too.
Active job cards do not show the Care handoff, Storm priority or 'Route +10%' badges that the available cards show, so the driver loses that context after accepting.
The Care Handoff and Storm Priority toggle buttons have no aria-pressed or role=switch, so screen readers cannot tell their state.
There is no link back to the home page or login from /verify.

action_items: CRITICAL: on driver cancel (and on the admin reassign/reopen paths), revert route-bundle payouts by restoring the base payout (store base_payout when the bundle is accepted) and clear route_bundle and bundle_bonus. Or apply the bonus as a separate field that is never folded into payout_amount, and do not bill the facility for the driver bonus unless that is intended.

HIGH: in /jobs/routes/accept, check on the server that all job_ids share the same normalized delivery_city (the same grouping as GET /jobs/routes). Apply the same eligibility filters as single accept (cold-chain cert, declined_by), and make each update atomic with update_one({id, status:'open'}) plus modified_count checks, rolling back on partial failure.
Make verify-seal write-once per stage, or block intact:true after a seal_exception, and decide whether a seal check is mandatory before pickup_confirmed / delivered.
Fix the copy-seal clipboard call in FacilityHomePage.js (try/catch around an awaited writeText); it currently triggers the runtime error overlay.
Fix seal_checks_passed so it counts only distinct checks on existing jobs, and normalise partner city names.
Add rate limiting to /api/public/verify/{code} and consider longer seal codes.
Show the care-handoff notice at pickup and add flag badges to My Jobs active cards.
critical_code_review_comments: accept_neighbourhood_route reads jobs and then writes with update_one({id}) without a status guard, so it is a TOCTOU race; the single accept_job path has the same pattern. Use conditional updates.
The bonus is folded permanently into payout_amount and offered_price, so every later read (billing, earnings, cancel, re-offer) inherits the inflated value. Keep base and bonus separate.
SealCheckCard is declared as a component inside ActiveDeliveryPage's render, so it is recreated on every render. Hoist it to module level.
server.py is 4479 lines, far over the 700-line guideline. The new routes, seal and public endpoints are good candidates for a separate router module.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested functional tests pass (10/10); 2 confirmed critical/high business-logic exploits plus 4 minor issues
success_rate.frontend: ~95%: all requested flows work; 1 uncaught runtime error (clipboard) and minor UX gaps

Their seal custody events remain (hash chain, not edited), which inflates seal_checks_passed. demo.driver's storm_ready was restored to its original value (true). demo.driver completed one delivery (de836347, since deleted); earnings rows may remain and the dashboard showed a $25.31 outstanding commission balance during the test.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_signature_features.py (it self-cleans). Re-run probe_it23_bundle_cancel.py: after the fix, payout must stay at base x1.10 across accept-cancel-reaccept and the facility must not see compounding. Re-run probe_it23.py: a cross-city bundle accept should return 400, and repeated verify-seal calls should be rejected. Test bundles by booking 2 facility requests with the dropoff in the same city ('<street>, <City>, ON'); bundle testid is route-bundle-{City} and button accept-bundle-{City}-btn. Pre-existing Toronto bundle jobs (seed) remain open.
rca_of_the_issue: Payout compounding: accept_neighbourhood_route sets payout_amount = base*1.1 where base is the current payout_amount. cancel_job (server.py ~2151) only resets status/accepted_by/assigned_driver_id/accepted_at, leaving the boosted payout and route_bundle=true. The job is open again and GET /jobs/routes groups it into a bundle again, so the next accept multiplies the already boosted value. Repro: book 2 jobs in one city, POST /jobs/routes/accept, POST /jobs/{id}/cancel for each within 5 minutes (free), repeat. Fix: persist base_payout at creation and always compute from it, and restore it on cancel/reopen.
